result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical content bug showing a raw localization key as a section title, and a minor layout clipping of a restaurant name.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw localization/i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the correct translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and ensure the localization lookup is wired correctly.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure adequate card width so the full name is visible.
